 About Bangladesh vs South Africa Bowl 1st Semi-Final
 The Bangladesh vs South Africa Bowl 1st Semi-Final in the HK Sixes, 2026 delivered an exciting contest at Mission Road Ground, Mong Kok on 31 October 2026, with both teams showcasing strong performances with bat and ball. Batting first, Bangladesh put up 129/4 (6.0) on the board, thanks to a solid knock from Habibur Sohan, who scored 60 runs, while Abu Hider provided valuable support. In reply, South Africa fought hard and reached 132/5 (6.0), with Jorich van Schalkwyk leading the chase with an important contribution. With the ball, Ayabulela Gqamane and Chowdhury Md Rizwan made a significant impact by picking up crucial wickets and controlling the run flow at key moments. This stats page gives fans a complete breakdown of batting and bowling performances, partnerships, strike rates, economy rates, and key match moments from the HK Sixes, 2026, helping readers understand how the game unfolded.
